findings.body:
**Deduplicate assistant usage by `message.id`.**

At `src/driver/claude-code/sdk.ts:1216`, every assistant frame adds its usage. The SDK can emit several frames with the same message ID and the same usage. Its accounting contract requires counting that measurement once. ([code.claude.com](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/cost-tracking))

If the stream ends without result usage, two such frames reporting 100 input tokens produce `usage.input=200` and inflated modeled cost. Track counted message IDs in the per-run observation. Continue collecting content from duplicate frames.
findings.title: Deduplicate assistant usage by `message.id`.

findings.body:
**Keep the result-frame cause when a dispatch exception follows an error result.**

At `src/driver/claude-code/sdk.ts:604-606`, a thrown query error sets `observation.errorKind` to `dispatch-threw` and sets `observation.error`. The guard at line 695 requires `observation.error === undefined`, so it skips the result-cause extraction at lines 696-710 when an error result is followed by a throw. The classifier receives `dispatch-threw`, which maps to `harness` unless the caught text matches the vendor limit vocabulary. The Claude Agent SDK documents that a single-shot `query()` raises after it yields an error result. The provider failure in that result can therefore be reported as a harness failure. This can change the error class that the runner receives.

Derive the result cause when the result frame has error status, and decide which classification applies to a result error followed by a throw.
findings.title: Keep the result-frame cause when a dispatch exception follows an error result.
